# Hash Future School

> Hash Future School is an AI-first online learning community focused on future-ready skills, self-directed learning, entrepreneurship, and meaningful education for children.

## Join Our Team
- Hash Future School invites people with an innovative mindset to apply through https://www.hashfuture.school/join
- The application asks for real achievements and proof of work rather than degrees or certificates
- Applicants are asked what they would like to change in the world and what they would contribute to this ecosystem
- Applications are stored in our database, emailed to the review team, and read by a human

## Awards & Recognition
- VBA Business Awards recognition (Kerala)

## Programs and Focus Areas
- AI-first learning approach
- Entrepreneurship and financial literacy
- Communication and confidence building
- Self-directed, real-world project-based learning

## Board Pathways and Admissions Facts
- Hash Future School guides and prepares learners for external boards: NIOS, Cambridge IGCSE (private candidate) and GED
- The school is NOT an NIOS-accredited institution and NOT a Cambridge-registered school; board certificates are issued by the respective boards through official exam centres
- Learners served: ages 6 to 17, across Lower, Middle and Higher Grades
- Mentor ratio: 1:8
- Community model: students learn with a global community of families across cities and countries, and each local cohort meets in person once a month
- Students collaborate on constructive projects rather than competing for rank, which is why peer bonds are described as unusually deep; families typically pair the programme with local sport, music or clubs so social contact is not only online
- Online classes are live; families join from across Kerala, other Indian states and abroad
